title: Affine algebra adjunction preserves finite limits
statement: Let f:X→Y be an affine scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let g be the canonical morphism to the direct image algebra space (Y,f_* O_X) [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], and let G=g_* be module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume G is a right adjoint and use its canonical left adjoint and adjunction. Then the canonical left adjoint preserves finite limits. Quasi-coherence is the property of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-module-correspondence].

proof.text: Obtain the concrete tensor pullback P, its object and morphism formulas, and an adjunction P ⊣ g_* from RingedSpace.exists_tensorModulePullback. The formulas determine the functor; no arbitrary object is chosen from mere existence.

Apply affine_algebra_tensorModulePullback_exact to f, P, and its prescribed object and morphism formulas. Its first conclusion gives PreservesFiniteLimits P. This includes all module sheaves and empty schemes.

Use Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq on P ⊣ g_* and Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint g_* to obtain P ≅ g_*.leftAdjoint. Transport finite-limit preservation using CategoryTheory.Limits.preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso.
